note.en: A river nerite of brackish water, small and patterned, known here from 3 museum records.
note.es: Una nerita de agua salobre, pequeña y con dibujos, conocida aquí por 3 registros de museo.

evidence: GBIF: 3 records in the region (specimens and observations)
recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 3 records in the region (specimens and observations).

marks.en: Small rounded neritid shell, smooth and variably patterned with bands, spots or zigzags.
marks.es: Concha pequena y redondeada de nerita, lisa y con dibujos variables de bandas, manchas o zigzags.
